newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Affin, UOB in broking venture.
newsitem.headline: Affin, UOB in broking venture.

text.p: Affin Holdings Bhd said on Monday it plans to set up a joint stockbroking venture with United Overseas Bank Ltd (UOB) of Singapore.
The stockbroking firm will start operations by the end of the year, Affin's managing director Lodin Wok Kamaruddin was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.
Affin will hold 55 percent of the new company's equity and UOB the rest, he said.
"We are awaiting approval from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) and the Securities Commission," he told reporters after Affin's annual general meeting.
The group has proposed that the stockbroking firm be named Affin-UOB Securities Sdn Bhd. It obtained a licence for the firm from the Finance Ministry last December.
Chief executive officer of the new stockbroking firm, Siti Norizam Mohd Yusoff said Affin Holdings is currently looking for key personnel.
She said the firm will have 100 million ringgit in shareholders fund initially, of which 50 million will be paid-up capital.
The firm, she added, will segment its target market in which institutional investors will be the priority.
